mapper.sql: id, title, type, status, delete_flag, created_by, created_dt, updated_by, updated_dt
mapper.insert: insert into sys_notice(title, type, status , delete_flag,created_by, created_dt, updated_by, updated_dt) values (#{title}, #{type}, 1 ,1, #{createdBy}, #{createdDt}, #{updatedBy}, #{updatedDt})
mapper.update: update sys_notice set delete_flag = -1 , updated_by = #{updatedBy} , updated_dt = #{updatedDt} where id = #{id}
mapper.select:
select count(1) from sys_notice where delete_flag = 1
limit 1

select from sys_notice where delete_flag = 1
limit #{startRow}, #{pageSize}
